segments.title: Flamingos are NOT born pink
segments.say: Flamingos aren't born pink. The chicks have gray feathers.

segments.title: The pink comes from FOOD
segments.say: The pink comes from pigments in their food. Tiny shrimp. And plankton.

segments.title: More pigment = BRIGHTER bird
segments.say: The more of those pigments a flamingo eats, the brighter it gets.

segments.title: Baby bills start pink, then go BLACK
segments.say: Even weirder: a chick's bill starts pink and turns black within about a week.
